SELECT a.*, e.name as employee_name FROM attendance_record a LEFT JOIN sys_employee e ON a.employee_id = e.id WHERE a.deleted = 0 AND a.status IN ('late', 'early', 'absent') ORDER BY a.attendance_date DESC
LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT e.name as employeeName, e.employee_no as employeeNo, COUNT(a.id) as totalDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'normal' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as normalDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'late' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as lateDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'early' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as earlyDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'absent' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as absentDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'leave' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as leaveDays, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN a.status = 'overtime' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) as overtimeDays FROM sys_employee e LEFT JOIN attendance_record a ON e.id = a.employee_id AND a.deleted = 0 AND DATE_FORMAT(a.attendance_date, '%Y-%m') = #{month} WHERE e.deleted = 0 GROUP BY e.id, e.name, e.employee_no ORDER BY e.employee_no ASC
